description: This Java class implements an HttpSessionListener that handles session lifecycle events, specifically performing cleanup when a session is destroyed within the context of the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: LoginEventListener
classes.description: A session listener that processes session creation and destruction events, mainly to handle login-related cleanup.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles actions when a session is created; currently does nothing but logs a verbose message.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a session is destroyed, specifically calling cleanupExternalLoginKey to remove external login keys.
